ordinance_area_text: in the northern part of the city beginning at the Chesapeake/Virginia Beach city line at its intersection with Centerville Turnpike, continuing on Centerville Turnpike in a southerly direction to its intersection with Mount Pleasant Road, continuing on Mount Pleasant Road in a westerly direction to its intersection with the railroad tracks, continuing along the railroad tracks extending northward to its intersection with the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway, continuing along the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway extending westward to its intersection with the Southern Branch of the Elizabeth River, continuing westward to its intersection with Interstate Route 64 and continuing along such road to its intersection with Interstate Route 664, continuing to its intersection with the Suffolk city line
notes: Line used: Centerville Tpk from the Virginia Beach line south to Mount Pleasant Rd; Mount Pleasant Rd west to the Norfolk Southern track; the track north to the Albemarle & Chesapeake Canal (AIWW, -76.2101,36.7222); the AIWW westward through Great Bridge to its junction with the Southern Branch main stem, then down the Southern Branch to the I-64 High Rise Bridge (-76.2993,36.7582); I-64 west to the Bowers Hill interchange; I-664 north to the Suffolk line. Area kept = the part of the city north of that line. Doubts: (1) 'continuing to its intersection with the Suffolk city line' after I-664 was read as following I-664 north to where it leaves the city; the alternative reading (straight from Bowers Hill west to the Suffolk line) would add the narrow strip of Chesapeake west of I-664 (Bowers Hill / Hodges Ferry edge) - treat that strip with caution. (2) 'continuing westward' from the AIWW/Southern Branch junction to I-64 was followed down the Southern Branch (which runs north there), not along Deep Creek. (3) The app's city outline is the generalized Census 1:500k boundary, so the northern city edge against Norfolk/Portsmouth is coarse and some real city land is missing at the edges. Within the area, only pellet shotguns on 50+ acre agricultural/conservation tracts with a police permit are allowed (plus the deer exceptions in (f)/(g)).
